scope: Source-only reachability check for EXT-D-0095: change signed-in identity while Profile remains mounted
source_basis: Current main source; no browser run, fixture mutation, or product edit

findings.path: Sidepanel Profile -> avatar menu Sign out -> sign in as another account
findings.outcome: Profile unmounts during the signed-out state before the second account can sign in; this route cannot verify an A-to-B transition in the same Profile mount.
anchors: src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx:542 UserMenu remains visible while Profile is selected
src/hooks/use-auth.ts:291-300 signOut clears user and broadcasts signed-out state
src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx:222-227 signed-out route switches to a public tab; 696-701 Profile TabsContent is conditional on access and is not forceMount
src/entrypoints/popup/main.tsx:108-149 popup shows Sign in only when user is absent

findings.path: Expired/rejected session or failed token refresh while Profile is open
findings.outcome: A terminal refresh-token rejection clears local session and broadcasts an auth change; canonical reread becomes guest and removes Profile. A stale 401 against a superseded bearer is ignored. Neither path supplies a second authenticated identity in the mounted Profile.
anchors: src/lib/auth/flow.ts:342-370 terminal refresh rejection compare-clears and broadcasts; a rotated token is adopted instead
src/lib/api/client.ts:818-838 exhausted 401 broadcasts only if rejected bearer is still current
src/hooks/use-auth.ts:229-243 auth broadcast rereads canonical session
src/hooks/use-auth.ts:80-132 unverified or mismatched saved identity resolves to guest
src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx:696-701 Profile is removed for guest

findings.path: Another extension context completes a different-account OAuth sign-in while the first account's Profile is still open
findings.outcome: The auth mechanism can replace stored user and bearer and notify the mounted panel. Its listener rereads verified canonical identity and useUserProfile rotates the owner without requiring a tab change. This is a conditional code path, not an established reproducible user route: the current popup and Settings expose Sign in only when that context is signed out, and no account-switch control was found for an already signed-in context.
anchors: src/lib/auth/flow.ts:458-478 successful OAuth commits bearer and USER_PROFILE together
src/hooks/use-auth.ts:229-243 receiver rereads verified canonical session; 161-170 sets the newly verified user directly
src/hooks/use-user-profile.ts:65-80 owner lifetime changes by user id and prior state is synchronously masked
src/features/settings/SettingsView.tsx:762-773 signed-in Settings offers Sign out; Sign in appears only for guest
src/entrypoints/popup/main.tsx:108-149 signed-in popup offers no Sign in

native_route: No deterministic supported UI route established for A-to-B while the same ProfileView remains mounted. Ordinary sign-out/sign-in is a valid two-account UI test but it creates a new Profile mount and cannot satisfy D95's stated cross-identity condition.
remaining_native_unknowns: Whether any real multi-context auth timing can deliver authenticated B directly while A's Profile remains mounted has not been observed.
D95 member behavior, failed second-owner read, and actual mounted cross-identity isolation remain unverified. Do not mark the criterion waived or the defect closed from source analysis.
